# Five Fall Design Trends to Make Your Home Feel Cozy and Inviting


Tri Pointe Homes Las Vegas


•


September 11, 2026


Share this article


Fall is the perfect time to make your home feel warmer and more inviting. But embracing the season doesn’t have to mean filling every room with pumpkins and plaid. At Tri Pointe Homes®, thoughtful design and effortless indoor-outdoor living create the perfect setting for embracing the season with warmth and style. According to **Bobby Berk, design expert, Emmy-winning TV host, and author** , a few thoughtful updates can create a cozy autumn atmosphere while keeping your space stylish and sophisticated.


**Start with texture** . Swap lightweight linen pillow covers for velvet, bouclé or a wool blend. This simple five-minute update adds warmth, depth and a tactile quality that instantly makes a room feel more suited to cooler weather.


**Color can have an equally powerful impact** . Introduce one moody, saturated shade through an accent such as a deep burgundy pillow, olive green vase or rust-colored throw. A single rich hue can shift the mood of a room without requiring a major redesign.


**Don’t overlook scent, either** . Berk recommends subtle fall fragrances like cedar, fig or warm amber rather than traditional pumpkin spice. The result is an understated seasonal feel that doesn’t overwhelm the space.


**Natural materials can also bring autumn indoors.** A stack of chunky, textural firewood placed near the fireplace creates instant lived-in warmth—even if you don’t plan to light a fire.


**Finally, extend that cozy feeling outdoors. A** rrange comfortable seating and a few blankets around a fire pit to create a welcoming gathering spot. As temperatures begin to dip, it gives family and friends a reason to linger outside and enjoy the season a little longer.
